initialization: Four independently randomized supported states; record actual states and RNG implementation. Do not initialize every chain from the common witness.

exact_kernel_checks.note: Numerical roundoff tolerance only; never silently clamp a materially negative probability. Detailed balance is required only when the chosen kernel claims reversibility.

sampling_accuracy_targets.diagnostic_scope: Energy and Hamming distance, computed across four post-warmup chains. Record site and pair uncertainty separately. Diagnostics are necessary checks, not proof of convergence.
sampling_accuracy_targets.constant_observable_rule: Waive variance-based diagnostics only when the target observable is provably constant; require its exact value. A constant sampled trace alone is insufficient.

broad_case_reference.method: Separate long direct-sampler runs after the direct kernel passes exact-model checks
broad_case_reference.status: Not run; reference adequacy must be demonstrated before broad-case accuracy claims
broad_case_reference.uncertainty_rule: Require absolute frequency error plus 1.96 times the combined candidate/reference MCSE to be at most 0.02. For means use 0.05 reference SD as the analogous upper bound. This is a fixed descriptive acceptance rule, not a simultaneous confidence guarantee.

budget.failure_rule: Record accuracy_not_reached or reference_inadequate at the cap. Do not turn a timeout into a successful time-to-accuracy result.

timing.primary_metric: Elapsed end-to-end time to the first predeclared checkpoint satisfying every applicable target across four chains
timing.hardware: Same recorded host and device for every condition; record CPU/GPU, thread settings, OS and package lock
timing.plan_policy: Tune only on development cases; freeze before evaluation and hold fixed within each run.

review_note: These are concrete proposed design choices, not measured results or evidence of adviser approval. Revise explicitly before the Week13 freeze if the adviser review or development evidence warrants it; never tune thresholds using evaluation outcomes.
